title: Expression and Purification of Protein
author: Yuan Yao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qaadsae
materials: The pure protein were pooled and dialyzed.

steps.title: Grow and induce culture
steps.instruction: Incubate BW25113/pRstA‑GFP cells in 50 mL LB medium containing chloramphenicol at 100 mg mL⁻¹; induce protein expression by adding IPTG to a final concentration of 1.0 mM.

steps.title: Harvest and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the culture by centrifugation and resuspend the cell pellet in 12 mL Lysis/Equilibration buffer supplemented with 120 µL lysozyme (10 mg mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Ice incubation and sonication
steps.instruction: Place the resuspended cells on ice for 30 min, then lyse the cells by sonication.

substeps.instruction: Lyse cells using a sonicator (parameters not specified).

steps.title: Clarify lysate by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 4 °C, 12 000 rpm for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the clarified supernatant to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Bind protein to Ni‑NTA agarose
steps.instruction: Incubate the supernatant with His‑Select Ni‑NTA Agarose (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA) overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Load onto Ni‑NTA resin
steps.instruction: The following day, load the supernatant onto Ni‑NTA affinity resin (Qigen, Germany).

steps.title: Assess purity by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Run SDS‑PAGE at 200 V for 45 minutes, then stain the gel with Coomassie blue for 15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Electrophorese gel at 200 V for 45 min.
Stain gel with Coomassie blue for 15 min.

steps.title: Determine concentration via BCA assay
steps.instruction: Analyze protein extracts using the BCA protein concentration quantitative method.
